questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What do we call the steps a computer follows?
questions.explanation: An algorithm is a clear set of steps for solving a task.

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: Which machine follows instructions to do a job?
questions.explanation: A computer follows instructions given by a person.

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What does a loop do in a program?
questions.explanation: A loop runs the same steps again and again.
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What is a bug in computing?
questions.explanation: A bug is a mistake that makes a program work wrongly.
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: Which one puts data in a computer?
questions.explanation: A keyboard is an input device. It sends letters and numbers in.

questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: Which one shows data from a computer?
questions.explanation: A screen is an output device. It shows the result.
questions.curriculumRef: NERDC Primary 4 Computer Studies, output devices
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What does a robot need before it can move?
questions.explanation: A robot only moves when a person gives it clear steps.
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What is AI short for?
questions.explanation: AI stands for artificial intelligence.

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: A robot moves 2 steps, then repeats this 3 times. How many steps in all?
questions.explanation: A loop repeats 2 steps three times, so 2 × 3 = 6.

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: Which instruction is a loop?
questions.explanation: Clap 3 times repeats the same action, so it is a loop.

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: If it is raining, take an umbrella. What is the condition?
questions.explanation: The condition is the test. Here it is whether it is raining.
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: A computer gives a wrong answer. What is the likely cause?
questions.explanation: A computer follows its instructions. Wrong steps give wrong answers.
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: Which is a sensible use of AI?
options: Suggesting a song you may like
questions.explanation: AI can suggest things from patterns, but it cannot do physical jobs by itself.

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What should you do before trusting an AI answer?
options: Check it with a book or teacher
questions.explanation: AI can be wrong, so check important answers with a trusted person or book.

questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: Which information should you not share with an AI chat?
questions.explanation: Personal details like your address should stay private.
questions.curriculumRef: NERDC Primary 5 Computer Studies, online safety
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: What is debugging?
questions.explanation: Debugging means finding bugs and fixing them.
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: A loop runs 4 times and adds 3 each time. What is the total?
questions.explanation: 4 × 3 = 12. The loop adds 3 four times.
questions.curriculumRef: NERDC Primary 6 Computer Studies, loops with numbers
questions.author: AI draft v1

questions.subject: code-ai
questions.text: The rule says: if score is more than 10, you win. The score is 10. What happens?
questions.explanation: 10 is not more than 10, so the winning step does not run.

questions.text: Why do the same AI questions get other answers later?
options: AI predicts words and can vary

questions.explanation: Different inputs show whether the program works in many cases.

questions.text: Why should a person review an AI answer?
options: AI can be wrong or unfair

questions.text: Why should you keep personal data private?
options: It can be copied and shared
